name: Twist
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Twist, host asynchronous team threads organized by channel and topic. The hard boundary is cross-platform apps, notifications, email integration, search, and doist reliability, plus network, moderation, and communication infrastructure.
